name: v1.0.14 — Redesign Parent Zone UI, Remove Volume Cap & Video App, Clean Camera, Quick Share Fixes
body:
## 🌸 Kids OS v1.0.14 Release Notes

### 📱 Parent Zone App Management Redesign
- **Fixed Landscape Soft Keyboard Blocking**: Added `stateHidden|adjustResize` to `ParentZoneActivity` and `flagNoExtractUi|actionSearch` to app search, with root focus guards so the keyboard never covers the app list on open.
- **Spacious 2-Line App Selection Cards**: Redesigned `item_parent_app.xml` into a clean 2-row layout with clearly visible, unclipped toggle switches, app category badge, and lock/remove buttons.

### 🔊 Volume Cap Completely Removed
- Completely removed volume limiter cap, restrictions, and observer loops across `PreferencesManager`, `MelodyGlobalService`, and `MainActivity`.
- Removed Sound & Volume card from Parent Zone.

### 📸 Clean Full-Screen Camera (Filters Removed)
- Removed all sticker frames and filter overlays completely from `MelodyCameraActivity`.
- Photos are captured directly in crisp native resolution.

### 🎬 Video App Completely Removed
- Deleted `MelodyVideoActivity` completely from the launcher, manifest, and file manager.

### ⚡ Quick Share Stability & Threading Fixes
- Replaced unbounded thread spawning with a dedicated 3-thread thumbnail executor with view-tag validation, preventing memory leaks and crashes during rapid gallery scrolling.
- Safely decoupled data queries from UI list notification.
- Fixed video handling in received files.
